programme.title: Busty Coeds vs. Lusty Cheerleaders
programme.desc: Ten college beauties go head-to-head in the Hottie of the Year contest. Angie Savage, Kylee Nash.

programme.title: Sound of Violence
programme.desc: As a child, the brutal murder of her family made Alexis regain her hearing along with synesthetic abilities. Now as an adult, she finds solace in the sounds of bodily harm. But when she's told she might lose her hearing again, she escalates her gruesome sound experiments in a quest to compose her masterpiece.

programme.title: Phantoms
programme.desc: Two sisters enter an isolated mountain town, only to discover that the entire population, save for the sheriff, his deputy and a history professor, has been ravaged by giant wormlike creatures who feed on human flesh. Based on the novel by Dean Koontz. Peter O'Toole, Rose McGowan, Joanna Going, Liev Schreiber, Nicky Katt, Ben Affleck.

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: Two teen girls clash with their new stepmother after the ghost of their mother warns them of the woman's evil intentions.

programme.title: Raging Grace
programme.desc: The thriller follows an undocumented immigrant from the Philippines named Joy. She is struggling to make a living to support her daughter in the United Kingdom. One day, Joy finds a well-paying job as a caretaker for a rich old man afflicted by a terminal disease. Soon, Joy finds out that the old man hides many dark secrets that can ruin everything she worked hard for.

programme.title: Jacob's Ladder
programme.desc: A Vietnam War veteran struggles with flashbacks and hallucinations. With the help of his new bride, he fights to keep sane while his brain fluctuates between reality and delusion.

programme.title: Ezra
programme.desc: Max Bernal, a struggling stand-up comedian, faces the daunting challenge of co-parenting his autistic son, Ezra, with his ex-wife, Jenna. Living with his father, Max grapples with tough choices regarding Ezra's future. Together, father and son embark on a transformative cross-country journey that bonds them in unexpected ways. What follows is a heartfelt tale of family resilience, humor, and compassion.

programme.title: Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow
programme.desc: In the 1930s, giant robots attack New York City, and a reporter teams up with ace aviator and former flame Joseph "Sky Captain" Sullivan to stop them before the world is destroyed.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: A cop in 2019 America is framed for massacring rioting civilians during a famine. After escaping from jail he tries to prove his innocence, but is captured along with an innocent civilian, and they are forced to participate in a violent game show called "The Running Man".

programme.title: The Gunman
programme.desc: A government agent goes on the run from his own agency, in an effort to try and clear his name.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: Two U.S. soldiers killed in Vietnam?one a decent man and the other a genocidal maniac?are turned into robot assassins by a secret government program. However, the pair resume their deadly rivalry when their memories return in this thrilling action film.

programme.title: Seabiscuit
programme.desc: A triumphant Cinderella story about the crowd-pleasing Depression-era thoroughbred Seabiscuit. Together, Seabiscuit's downtrodden jockey, wizened trainer and entrepreneurial owner lead the horse to several victories that helped to inspire a Americans during the downtrodden 1930s.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
